Minecraft Let's Play's in general are different than they used to be, but my Minecraft Let's Play should be closer to that old-school style of Minecraft Let's Play and I really do hope you enjoy it! If you read this far, comment your favorite animal so I can see how many people actually read this! Thank you so much for watching :) Play with me on RainyDay, my very own Skyblock server!
